# Supplemental license notices

These packages declare MIT licensing but omit the full license text from their npm distribution. The notice generator includes these version-specific supplements and fails on unknown missing notices.

- `react-remove-scroll-bar@2.3.8`: [upstream license](https://github.com/theKashey/react-remove-scroll-bar/blob/master/LICENSE), copyright 2025 Anton Korzunov.
- `rehype-katex@7.0.1` and `remark-math@6.0.0`: [remark-math monorepo license](https://github.com/remarkjs/remark-math/blob/main/license), copyright Junyoung Choi.

The MIT grant is reproduced using the same standard MIT text distributed with react-remove-scroll; the copyright notices above are retained from the respective upstream repositories. Review these supplements when updating those packages.
